audit.why: Radiant Blast is 12/11/10/9/8s, Divine Judgment 160/120/80s, Celestial Blessing a flat 15s. Those numbers are the whole trade clock in a lane decided before her first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Starfire Spellblade being an auto-attack reset, and Celestial Blessing's healing was only referenced as 'his healing' with no timing.

audit.corrected: Reset tell named in the don'ts; anti-heal tied to Celestial Blessing's 15s in itemization.
